page.notes: The two columns are set as parallel lists; the left column is printed first, then the right. Greek entries are transcribed approximately from a small scan and may contain errors. Several entries on the right are partly obscured by the binding; the lines "Finis & forma" and "Fœdus quare" are read with uncertainty. Lines with ambiguous page numbers are marked as printed. The Greek words in the left column (Ἐπιτιμᾶν, Ἐπιείκεια, Ἐπιστίχεια) and "Ἐᵓλογρημεία" are uncertain.
